about: Real weeks for HOME BY SEVEN. Radiation: LRO CRaTER D1D2 absorbed dose rate (µGy/h, hourly), NASA OSDR RadLab. Events: DONKI (CCMC). Built by scripts/data/weeks.mjs. ratio = day mean / normal (25th percentile of the 27 days before). Measured near the Moon behind thin shielding; an archive, not a live feed.
